title: 3dSynthesize
description: Reads a '-cbucket' dataset and a '.xmat.1D' matrix from 3dDeconvolve, and synthesizes a fit dataset using selected sub-bricks and matrix columns.

c_bucket.description: Input dataset from 3dDeconvolve via the '-cbucket' option.
c_bucket.title: Cbucket dataset

matrix.description: Matrix file from 3dDeconvolve via the '-x1D' option.
matrix.title: Matrix file

select.description: Select columns from the matrix and corresponding sub-bricks from the cbucket. Can use forms like 'baseline', 'polort', 'allfunc', 'allstim', 'all', 'something', or numbers/ranges.
select.title: Select columns

prefix.description: Output result into dataset with the specified name.
prefix.title: Output prefix

dry_flag.description: Don't compute the output, just check the inputs.
dry_flag.title: Dry run

tr.description: Set TR in the output to the specified value.
tr.title: Repetition Time (TR)

cenfill.description: How censored time points from 3dDeconvolve will be filled (options: 'zero', 'nbhr', 'none').
cenfill.title: Censor fill option
